subject: Important Update: Meeting Rescheduled
body: Dear Team, I hope this message finds you well. Due to unforeseen circumstances, the weekly team meeting scheduled for tomorrow has been rescheduled to Friday at the same time. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding. Please make note of the new date and time in your calendars. Thank you for your attention to this matter. Best regards, [Your Name]
